posts.t: Nazar gets another goal for Chicago to tie the game. Tipped a point shot at the front of the net and beat Alex Lyon. Sabres and Blackhawks tied at 2.
@suesswassersee.bsky.social @schatzipage.bsky.social I assume you two helped manifest Alex Lyon returning to play since they’re in Chicago tonight
Alex Lyon has been activated from injured reserve, per the NHL Media site, and Konsta Helenius is now on injured reserve.
Sabres place Konsta Helenius on injured reserve, activate Alex Lyon
Alex Lyon is off IR; Konsta Helenius is placed on IR to make room for him. Was wondering if he might get the call tonight before yesterday’s no good terrible bad game. Now I’m wondering even harder.
The Sabres have activated Alex Lyon from injured reserve and placed Konsta Helenius on injured reserve to make room.
Lindy Ruff said Ryan McLeod will be back in the lineup tomorrow. He also said Alex Lyon will be on the road trip that begins Thursday in Chicago and is on target to return soon.
